question: Which piece in the game of chess can move two squares vertically and one square horizontally, and vice versa, in an 'L' shape?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Knight**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Knight** is the only piece in chess that moves in an 'L' shape.
 
• The 'L' shape movement consists of two squares in one direction (either vertically or horizontally) and then one square in a perpendicular
